overall: The AG found the Board's December 7 minutes substantially complied with the accuracy requirement and did not violate the Open Meeting Law; it only recommended limiting editorializing about tone in future minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the December 7 meeting were insufficiently detailed, failing to reflect what was said by all parties.
allegations.key_passage: Although the minutes do not include every remark made by members of the public as well as Board members, they contain an adequate summary of the comments.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 7 minutes were inaccurate and 'sugar coated' in favor of Board members, making public speakers appear problematic.
allegations.key_passage: Nonetheless, overall we find the minutes of the Board’s December 7 minutes to be accurate and quite detailed, and we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
